blockers.title: A quick CI run still vouches for a full one: ci-scope's induction ignores the new tier, so a docs-only [full-ci] commit on top of a quick-green code commit gets a 'Full verification' run with no browser suite, and the milestone and test-site gates accept it
blockers.evidence: scripts/ci-scope.mjs:37-43 latestRunPassed accepts any successful push run of the parent; its header comment (lines 5-7) still says 'By induction that commit's code passed the browser suite', which stopped being true when db64706 added the quick tier. ci.yml then skips every browser step, but run-name still says 'Full verification', so isFullRun in scripts/milestone.mjs:261 and scripts/deploy-test-site.mjs:81 passes.
blockers.reproduction: Node: a quick parent run makes needsBrowser([.evidence/..., .milestones/...], latestRunPassed(p)) return false. Fix: latestRunPassed requires isFullRun.

blockers.title: The iPhone-viewport grep silently drops 'export feedback stays above the bottom bar (device)': the parentheses are a regex group
blockers.reproduction: npx playwright test --list --project=iphone-13-viewport prints 1 test. Fix: escape, or build the regex from escaped literal titles and fail when an entry matches nothing.

importantFindings.title: The tier expression is duplicated in ci.yml, and nothing tests that the copies agree or that the milestone and deploy gates reject a quick run
